displayName: Foundry accounts should have a Key Vault connection
description: Audit project-enabled AIServices accounts without an account-level AzureKeyVault connection with a nonempty target. A project-only connection or an unrelated vault in the same resource group does not satisfy this account-level check. Does not require customer-managed encryption or verify secret access, RBAC, target existence, or runtime use.

builtInReview.gap: No Foundry connection-presence audit was found among 2862 live built-ins. CMK policies check encryption, not a Key Vault secrets connection. The category and target aliases were verified in the live Cognitive Services provider.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists reports a missing related connection without changing the account. Deny cannot implement this related-resource existence check.
